H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H4687: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
H2654: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H2233: seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H2224: properly, to irradiate (or shoot forth beams), i.e. to rise (as the sun); specifically, to appear (as a symptom of leprosy)
H2822: the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H3867: properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend
H3557: properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4131: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H5564: to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively, to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H6340: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H7161: a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H3707: to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H4549: to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief)
H8378: a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm)
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
